quotes.t: One CV in, three CV out: a chord module. The builder's own design; photos follow once it is built and tested.

blurb.en: One pitch CV in, three out, voiced as a chord. 4HP, the builder's own design. Not yet for sale.

blurb.sv: En tonhöjds-CV in, tre ut, stämda som ett ackord. 4HP, byggarens egen konstruktion. Inte till salu ännu.
